label: TP
reason: User input from request.getParameterValues flows through param to bar and reaches the printf sink. The conditional sanitization (replacing last character with \"Z\" when length > 1) does not adequately prevent XSS - malicious payloads like <script> remain executable even with trailing character change.

evidence.note: User input flows from getParameterValues through param/bar to printf sink
Conditional sanitization replaces only last character with Z, insufficient for XSS prevention
